acceptance.given: A disposable authorized inspection root contains fixed package bytes and unchanged standard, policy and schema bytes. Frozen test code defines multiple distinguishable diagnostics and their expected ordering independently of candidate-controlled policy.

oracle.expected: For each public interface, the two results have equivalent structured content and identical diagnostic sequences. Each sequence also matches the independently specified sorted order; comparing sorted copies alone is insufficient.
forbidden: Repeated executions with identical package bytes and policy produce materially different content.
Equivalent diagnostic items appear in different orders between executions.
Both executions return the same unsorted diagnostic sequence.
An unconditional pass result satisfies the diagnostic-order assertions.
oracle.observable: During scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a06, compare the actual returned structures from two direct validate_package calls and the parsed JSON from two subprocess CLI calls; inspect diagnostic ordering before applying any comparison normalization.

acceptance.then: Repeated results are equivalent and their diagnostics are sorted consistently for both the Python entry and public CLI.
acceptance.when: The test invokes scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package twice and the module CLI twice against the same unchanged input bytes and policy, then evaluates equivalence and ordering using obligation-specific assertions.
